attributes.description: Raw security_config_change payloads, one row per event, newest first - API key creation, change and invalidation, user profile writes, role and privilege edits. Kibana's own API-key clean-up (invalidate_apikeys by a platform service account through no named key) is left out, as on the Config changes tile. The field is a JSON string, shown verbatim. client.ip is not kept: Elasticsearch does not record it on security config events. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query":{"esql":"SET unmapped_fields=\"nullify\"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL AND NOT (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == \"invalidate_apikeys\" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN (\"elastic.maintenance\",\"autoscaling\",\"elasticsearch-controller\",\"elastic/fleet-server\",\"elastic/kibana\") AND api_key.name IS NULL) | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, \"<anonymous>\") | KEEP @timestamp, actor, event.action, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change | SORT @timestamp DESC | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE \"[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}\" AND NOT actor RLIKE \"[0-9]{20}\"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), \"… · Cloud API key\"), actor) | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, event.action AS Action, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change AS Change"},"index":{"id":"cloud-audit-adhoc-dv","title":"logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*","timeFieldName":"@timestamp","sourceFilters":[],"type":"esql","fieldFormats":{},"runtimeFieldMap":{},"allowNoIndex":false,"name":"logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*","allowHidden":false},"filter":[],"highlightAll":true,"version":true}
